description: This file provides Spring Security configuration for a Java web application using Spring Security 6. It defines a security filter chain that disables CSRF, configures headers for H2 console support, permits unauthenticated access to specified endpoints (such as API docs, Swagger UI, H2 console, and health check), and enforces HTTP Basic authentication for remaining requests.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class with security filter chain bean setup for Spring Security.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines security settings: disables CSRF, configures headers for H2 console, permits certain endpoints without authentication, and enables HTTP Basic authentication for others.
